purpose: Fixed release comparison after a challenger-first defense and counter-adaptation cycle

decision.budget: 64 full ordinary games, 32 per frozen defender. Same opponent and map weights for both; uncontrolled starts and alternate execution slots. Preserve all caps, losses and errors. Review all candidate failures/caps and selected defense/scout examples. This exposed development pool is not a formal generalization evaluation. Pressure adaptations that underperformed were not promoted; the original effective pressure package is versioned separately.
